issues.description: Lecture.addGuestStudents has an inconsistent public API across artifacts: the problem statement/UML requires addGuestStudents(int): void, and the solution implements public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents), but the template provides public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput). Students following the template will implement the wrong signature and may fail compilation against the tests expecting the 1-parameter method.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template to match the specified/expected signature: replace `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput)` with `public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents)`. If validation is desired, perform it internally or via a private helper without changing the public method signature.
